options.name: members
options.description: Desired list of account UUIDs to maintain as group members. UUIDs must include curly braces, e.g. C({c423e13e-b541-3e77-b363-3e0b458u8226}). The module reconciles membership to exactly match this list — missing members are added and extra members are removed. When omitted, existing membership is left unchanged.

options.name: name
options.description: The display name of the group. Required when C(state=present).

options.name: permission
options.description: Default permission automatically granted to the group on all newly created repositories in the workspace.

options.name: repo_permissions
options.description: List of repositories and the privilege level the group should have on each of them. The module reconciles permissions to exactly match this list — missing privileges are added, out-of-date ones are updated, and privileges on repositories not in the list are revoked. When omitted (C(null)), existing repository permissions are left unchanged. Pass an empty list C([]) to revoke all existing repository permissions.

options.name: slug
options.description: The group slug (identifier) used to look up an existing group. When omitted the slug is derived from C(name) by replacing spaces with dashes and lowercasing. Useful when C(state=absent) and the group name is not known.

options.name: state
options.description: C(present) ensures the group exists and is configured as specified. C(absent) ensures the group does not exist.

options.name: workspace
options.description: The workspace ID (slug) that owns the group.
